headline: Food stocks lead the market as CFRESH jumps 16.04% on a 13.2σ volume spike.
market_take: The coverage universe showed strong activity in FOOD, with several stocks posting double‑digit moves and extreme volume. Construction (CONS) displayed mixed signals, highlighted by EMC's 100% open‑gap and TPOLY's 18.18% drop. Property (PROP) had a notable 50% five‑day gain in KC, while PF&REIT faced pressure from SIRIPRT's 11.54% decline and a -100% price gap in TIF1. Multiple earnings and governance filings were recorded across CONMAT and CONS, adding background to the price action.

sector_notes.note: CFRESH surged 16.04% with a 13.2σ volume spike; MADAME added 12.12% intraday; ITC posted a 4.5σ volume spike and 6.13% rise; XBIO fell 11.11% intraday.
EMC opened with a +100.00% price gap; TPOLY dropped 18.18% on modest volume; SOLAR rose 9.09% with a 5.2σ volume spike; RT and TEAMG each saw volume spikes above 6σ.
KC recorded a +50.00% five‑day gain; CGD added 10.00% on the day; J and JCK posted intraday gains of 7.53% and 8.33% respectively; BROCK and EVER declined sharply with low volume.
SIRIPRT fell 11.54% on very high volume (15.03×); TNPF showed a 5.7σ volume spike; TIF1 opened with a -100.00% price gap; PF declined 20% over five days.
No price moves, but director change at PPPM and an information memo from PCE were filed.
Multiple earnings and strategic investment filings were released, including a smart‑toilet venture, but no significant price moves today.

risk_flags: SIRIPRT's sharp decline on very high volume suggests heightened selling pressure.
EMC's 100% open‑gap may indicate a one‑off event; monitor for follow‑through.
TIF1's -100% open‑gap signals a possible trading halt or error; treat with caution.
TPOLY's 18.18% drop could reflect sector weakness in construction.
PF's 20% five‑day decline adds to PF&REIT sector risk.
